name: core.openwop.workflows.insights-suite
description: Insights & Drafting meta-workflows as an RFC 0013 chain pack (migrated from the deprecated ADR 0082/0072 builtins, ADR 0472 Phase 2). Three real source→analysis→LLM→draft→notify pipelines over BYOK-connected sources. chainIds keep the original `openwop-app.insights.*` ids so scheduler/trigger ignition + replay are unchanged; the chains are also gallery-editable. 1.2.0 (ADR 0599 §5): each hard-required value is a chain PARAMETER bound as a WHOLE-VALUE `{{params.X}}` on a top-level node `inputs` entry, and data edges are port-qualified on BOTH sides. NOTIFY AUDIENCE (1.3.0 ADR 0600 §5; STATED in 1.3.1 §Correction 6): `self` resolves from the run's ACTING USER and refuses fail-closed without one, so a scheduled/webhook fire of `talent-prep` or `anniversary-draft` loses its completion notification — deliberate, since the alternative broadcasts a colleague's 9-box score or recognition draft workspace-wide. `weekly-variance` keeps `tenant`: no declared PII, and its only lane is the scheduler.
